project: Feature Flag Smith Feature Tasks Kanban Enabled Prd
overview: As an operator, I want non-running queued tasks grouped in Scheduled so I can see what is ready to refine or launch.
goals: Group non-running queued tasks into a Scheduled lane in the feature tasks Kanban view.
Keep running and completed tasks out of the Scheduled lane.
Make the Scheduled lane useful for refinement and launch planning workflows.
Ensure lane assignment behavior is deterministic and testable.
nonGoals: Changing task execution order or scheduler behavior.
Introducing new task statuses beyond current queued/running/completed states.
Redesigning the full Kanban layout outside the Scheduled lane addition.
successMetrics: 100% of non-running queued tasks appear in Scheduled after board refresh.
0 running tasks appear in Scheduled in acceptance test scenarios.
Operators can identify refinement-ready tasks in under 10 seconds during usability checks.
Lane assignment tests pass consistently in CI.
openQuestions: Should blocked queued tasks appear in Scheduled or a separate lane?
Should Scheduled tasks be sorted by created time, priority, or planned launch date?
Do filters and search apply before or after Scheduled lane grouping?

stack.backend: Existing task API and status model

uiNotes: Add a Scheduled lane label that is visually consistent with existing lanes.
Show task count in the Scheduled lane header.
Keep drag-and-drop behavior aligned with current Kanban interactions.
Ensure Scheduled lane is visible and usable on standard operator viewport sizes.

stories.title: Add Scheduled lane to Kanban board
stories.description: Introduce a Scheduled lane in the feature tasks Kanban view to display non-running queued tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: Lane appears on initial board load without feature flags beyond the requested one.
Scheduled lane header displays the current number of tasks in that lane.

stories.title: Map non-running queued tasks into Scheduled
stories.description: Apply lane-assignment rules so queued tasks that are not running are placed in Scheduled.
acceptanceCriteria: A task with queued status and non-running state appears in `Scheduled`.
A running task never appears in `Scheduled`.
A completed task never appears in `Scheduled`.

stories.title: Keep Scheduled lane updated on task state changes
stories.description: Ensure tasks move in or out of Scheduled immediately when their state changes between queued/non-running and other states.
acceptanceCriteria: When a Scheduled task transitions to running, it leaves `Scheduled` without page reload.
When a running task transitions back to queued non-running, it enters `Scheduled`.
Board refresh preserves correct lane placement for all transitioned tasks.

stories.title: Support operator refinement workflow in Scheduled
stories.description: Allow operators to inspect and prioritize Scheduled tasks for refinement or launch readiness.
acceptanceCriteria: Operator can open task details from `Scheduled` using existing interaction patterns.
Priority or planning metadata already available on tasks is visible from Scheduled cards.
Operator can distinguish refinement-ready tasks from other lanes using lane context alone.

stories.title: Add automated tests for Scheduled lane rules
stories.description: Create unit or integration tests covering the lane-assignment logic and regression cases for Scheduled.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover queued non-running, queued running, and completed task cases.
Tests validate real-time transition behavior for entering and leaving `Scheduled`.
CI fails when Scheduled mapping rules regress.
